title: Adequate Advance Notice for Families of Death Row Inmates before Executions
what_it_is: Adequate Advance Notice for Families of Death Row Inmates before Executions

sections.label: Prison Service inmate family requests
sections.summary: The Singapore Prison Service facilitates inmate and family requests while ensuring safety, and physical contact has not been allowed for safety reasons.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Singapore Prison Service facilitates requests from the inmate and his family as much as possible, while ensuring the safety and security of inmates and their families.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Physical contact has not been allowed for reasons connected with safety.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: There will be a period of time between conviction and the carrying out of the sentence to allow the full legal process to be completed, including any clemency petition.

sections.label: Counsellors for inmate families
sections.summary: Counsellors are attached to each family to support them before and after the sentence is carried out.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Counsellors are attached to each family to support them during the period leading up to and after the carrying out of the sentence.

sections.label: Informing next-of-kin timing
sections.summary: The Singapore Prison Service considers various factors in deciding how far in advance to inform the inmate's next-of-kin.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Singapore Prison Service considers various factors in determining how far in advance to inform the inmate's next-of-kin.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Often, this includes the time needed for his next-of-kin and family to travel to Singapore if they live overseas.

sections.label: Physical contact requests assessment
sections.summary: Physical contact has not been allowed due to operational security and visitor safety, but family and next-of-kin requests will always be assessed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On the question of whether physical contact will be allowed, I have said earlier that the practice has been no, because of operational security and the safety of visitors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But we will always assess requests from families and next-of-kin as they are provided.
